如果您想了解 Ideogram 4 + KJ Prompt Builder 工作流程在实践中的工作原理，请先观看完整视频。该视频展示了如何使用结构化 JSON 提示来控制 ComfyUI 内的海报布局、版式、构图、调色板、对象放置和整体视觉方向。

此 ComfyUI 工作流程专为使用 KJ Prompt Builder 的 Ideogram 4 视觉合成控制而设计。它的主要目的不仅仅是生成漂亮的图像，而是让图像生成过程更像一个视觉设计系统。该工作流程不是编写一种松散的自然语言提示，而是使用结构化 JSON 样式提示和视觉合成构建器来定义背景、主题元素、文本块、边界框、调色板、样式方向、照明和输出比率。

工作流程围绕 ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors 作为主要 Ideogram 4 模型构建。它还使用 ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors 作为无条件模型分支，qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors 作为 Ideogram 4 文本编码器，flux2-vae.safetensors 作为 VAE，Ideogram4Scheduler，DualModelGuider，CFGOverride，EmptyFlux2LatentImage，SamplerCustomAdvanced，VAEDecode，SaveImage，和多个 Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ 节点。

此工作流程中最重要的部分是 Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ。该节点允许用户将视觉提示组织成更可控的布局格式。您可以描述全局图像概念、背景、风格、灯光、媒介、调色板和各个元素。每个元素都可以被视为一个对象或文本块，具有自己的位置、描述、文本内容和调色板。这对于中文海报、缩略图、标题图像、品牌视觉效果、概念艺术和布局很重要的设计密集型图像特别有用。

该工作流程还包括多个准备好的示例组，例如中国电影海报布局、赛车海报、现实纪录片风格场景、中国奇幻世界建筑、解谜冒险环境、F1赛车、MotoGP赛车、游戏展示视觉效果、动作恐怖生存场景和反乌托邦地下科幻作品。这些示例使工作流程不仅仅是一个生成图；它成为一个实用的视觉提示库，用于学习结构化 Ideogram 4 提示的工作原理。

另一个重要部分是双模制导结构。主 Ideogram 4 模型遵循提示，而无条件模型提供基线。 DualModelGuider 将一代人推向结构化提示目标。 CFGOverride 控制后续采样过程中的引导行为，有助于保持结果一致，而不会过度强制模型。

该工作流程还包括用于控制宽高比的分辨率选择器。在此版本中，默认方向为 21:9 超宽，特别适合电影横幅、YouTube 封面、海报主视觉和宽幅概念艺术。宽度和高度自动与有效值对齐，减少分辨率错误。

与普通的文本到图像的工作流程相比，这种设置更适合面向设计的生成。当您需要可读的文本、稳定的海报布局、清晰的构图层次结构、受控的对象放置、高级封面设计和可重复的提示结构时，它非常有用。

主要特点：

  • Ideogram 4 视觉合成导演工作流程

  • KJ Prompt Builder 结构化提示控件

  • JSON风格的布局和元素描述

  • 支持对象块和文本块

  • 更好地控制中文海报排版

  • 表意4 FP8主力车型路线

  • 表意文字4无条件模型分支

  • Qwen3-VL 8B 表意文字文本编码器

  • Flux2 VAE 解码

  • DualModelGuider制导结构

  • CFGOverride引导控制

  • Ideogram4Scheduler 具有质量/默认/Turbo 预设

  • 分辨率选择器宽高比控制

  • 21:9超宽海报和封面设计支持

  • 多个内置视觉提示示例

建议的工作流程：

首先选择输出比率。对于电影封面和海报布局，请使用 21:9 超宽设置。然后在 JSON 提示中编写主要思想或使用 Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ 组织场景。定义高级图像描述、背景、美学、灯光、媒介、调色板和关键元素。对于海报作品，请将标题和标语作为单独的文本元素放置，而不是将它们混合到一个段落中。从默认模式开始测试布局。如果构图正确，请切换到质量模式以获得更精美的结果。如果您只想快速测试，请使用 Turbo 模式。如果排版不稳定，简化文字，减少不必要的元素，保持布局 干净的。

Watch the full video first if you want to understand how this Ideogram 4 + KJ Prompt Builder workflow works in practice. The video shows how structured JSON prompts can be used to control poster layout, typography, composition, color palette, object placement, and overall visual direction inside ComfyUI.

This ComfyUI workflow is designed for Ideogram 4 visual composition control using KJ Prompt Builder. Its main purpose is not only to generate a beautiful image, but to make the image generation process more like a visual design system. Instead of writing one loose natural-language prompt, this workflow uses structured JSON-style prompting and a visual composition builder to define background, subject elements, text blocks, bounding boxes, color palettes, style direction, lighting, and output ratio.

The workflow is built around ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors as the main Ideogram 4 model. It also uses ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors as the unconditional model branch, qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors as the Ideogram 4 text encoder, flux2-vae.safetensors as the VAE, Ideogram4Scheduler, DualModelGuider, CFGOverride, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, SamplerCustomAdvanced, VAEDecode, SaveImage, and multiple Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ nodes.

The most important part of this workflow is Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ. This node allows the user to organize a visual prompt into a more controllable layout format. You can describe the global image concept, background, style, lighting, medium, color palette, and individual elements. Each element can be treated as an object or text block, with its own position, description, text content, and palette. This is especially useful for Chinese posters, thumbnails, title images, brand visuals, concept art, and design-heavy images where placement matters.

The workflow also includes multiple prepared example groups, such as Chinese movie poster layouts, racing posters, realistic documentary-style scenes, Chinese fantasy worldbuilding, puzzle-adventure environments, F1 racing, MotoGP racing, gaming showcase visuals, action-horror survival scenes, and dystopian underground sci-fi compositions. These examples make the workflow more than a single generation graph; it becomes a practical visual prompt library for learning how structured Ideogram 4 prompting works.

Another important part is the dual-model guidance structure. The main Ideogram 4 model follows the prompt, while the unconditional model provides the baseline. DualModelGuider pushes the generation toward the structured prompt target. CFGOverride controls the guidance behavior during the later sampling process, helping keep the result aligned without over-forcing the model.

The workflow also includes a ResolutionSelector for aspect ratio control. In this version, the default direction is 21:9 ultra-wide, which is especially suitable for cinematic banners, YouTube covers, poster key visuals, and wide-format concept art. Width and height are automatically aligned to valid values, reducing resolution errors.

Compared with ordinary text-to-image workflows, this setup is more suitable for design-oriented generation. It is useful when you need readable text, stable poster layout, clear composition hierarchy, controlled object placement, premium cover design, and repeatable prompt structure.

Main features:

  • Ideogram 4 visual composition director workflow

  • KJ Prompt Builder structured prompt control

  • JSON-style layout and element description

  • Supports object blocks and text blocks

  • Better control over Chinese poster typography

  • Ideogram 4 FP8 main model route

  • Ideogram 4 unconditional model branch

  • Qwen3-VL 8B Ideogram text encoder

  • Flux2 VAE decoding

  • DualModelGuider guidance structure

  • CFGOverride guidance control

  • Ideogram4Scheduler with Quality / Default / Turbo presets

  • ResolutionSelector aspect ratio control

  • 21:9 ultra-wide poster and cover design support

  • Multiple built-in visual prompt examples

Suggested workflow:

Start by choosing the output ratio first. For cinematic covers and poster layouts, use the 21:9 ultra-wide setting. Then write the main idea in the JSON prompt or use Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ to organize the scene. Define the high-level image description, background, aesthetics, lighting, medium, color palette, and key elements. For poster work, place the title and tagline as separate text elements instead of mixing them into one paragraph. Start with Default mode to test the layout. If the composition is correct, switch to Quality mode for a more polished result. If you only want fast testing, use Turbo mode. If the typography is unstable, simplify the text, reduce unnecessary elements, and keep the layout clean.
